products.name: Brisk Teaching
products.note: AI: Browser extension for feedback, quizzes, reading level changes and lesson materials inside Google Docs, Slides and YouTube. Who: Teachers; students through teacher-guided activities. Student age: Under 13 only with school consent under COPPA, or parent consent outside school. Privacy: Student Data Privacy Pledge signatory; states FERPA and COPPA compliance; Student Data Privacy Addendum and state data privacy agreements; 1EdTech TrustEd Apps certified. Price: Free plan for teachers; school and district plans priced per student on request.
